# Recorded runs

amdl 0.1.4's output for In Rainbows, recorded on 2026-11-04 in the shelf
image against a signed-in wrapper-lite, with the rendered config and the
runner's folders. They merge stdout and stderr, as the runner reads them,
and keep the bars' `\r` redraws.

- `in-rainbows-fresh.txt`: the first run, which wrote all 10 songs.
- `in-rainbows-exists.txt`: a second run over those files.
- `in-rainbows-atmos.txt`: a run with `--atmos`; the album has no Dolby
  Atmos version.
